name: Upland Town Square
demographics: Upland Town Square serves an affluent trade area with average household incomes exceeding $116,000 within a 3-mile radius and $127,909 within 1 mile. The center attracts a diverse mix of families and professionals from the surrounding residential communities, with a population of over 162,000 within 3 miles. The proximity to Upland High School with 3,000+ students brings a significant youth demographic, while the grocery-anchored format appeals to regular weekly shoppers focused on convenience and value. The location on the main retail corridor in the Inland Empire positions it as a neighborhood destination for middle to upper-middle class households seeking everyday services and dining options.
description: Upland Town Square is a well-positioned community shopping center located at 847 West Foothill Boulevard in Upland, California, offering 100,090 square feet of retail space. Anchored by Sprouts Farmers Market, the center features a strong mix of national and local tenants including Sola Salon Studios, Great Clips, O'Reilly Auto Parts, Pet Supplies Plus, Jimmy John's, and Dutch Bros Coffee, providing a comprehensive range of services for the local community. The property benefits from exceptional visibility along West Foothill Boulevard with over 28,000 vehicles passing daily, and convenient access within 2 miles of both I-10 and Highway 210 on the main retail corridor in the Inland Empire. Serving an affluent trade area with average household incomes exceeding $116,000 within 3 miles, the center is strategically located near Upland High School, one of the largest high schools in the Foothill Corridor with over 3,000 students. The diverse tenant mix includes fitness concepts like Mayweather Boxing + Fitness and HOTWORX, dining options such as Denny's, WaBa Grill, and Red Devil Pizza, and essential services including Pacific Dental Services, Wells Fargo, and H&R Block, making it a true one-stop destination for the surrounding neighborhoods.
summary: Upland Town Square is a 100,090 square foot Sprouts-anchored community center featuring 28 national and local retailers on West Foothill Boulevard. The property serves an affluent trade area with household incomes over $116,000 and benefits from high visibility with 28,000+ daily vehicle traffic.
